## **Input any document**

Input PDFs, scanned images, spreadsheets, and slides including text, tables, charts, and handwritten elements.

## **Outputs structured text**

Document Parse outputs structured, machine-readable formats, such as HTML and Markdown.

## Faster, more accurate, built for scale

[Start with API](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started?utm_source=feature-cta&utm_medium=web-product-dp&utm_campaign=documentparse&utm_content=start-with-api)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6743d5190bb2b52f38e99e37/6808f6d0d21e829de3ce7f4f_DP_results_web(0423).avif)

## More features

This enhancement expands the range of recognized information, increases accuracy, and streamlines workflows for enterprise users.

- **Complex tables**

- **Chart recognition**

- **Element coordinates**


[Learn more](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/introducing-chart-recognition-in-upstage-document-parse)

## Fast processing speed

This speed ensures that your workflows remain uninterrupted and efficient.

- **0.6 seconds per page on average**

- **Processes 100 pages in under a minute**

- **5–10x faster** than competitors


[Learn more](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/let-llms-read-your-documents-with-speed-and-accuracy)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6743d5190bb2b52f38e99e37/6808bf902d860f6bb79d6dab_dp%20comparison%20graph_speed(0422).avif)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6743d5190bb2b52f38e99e37/6808bf902d860f6bb79d6db3_dp%20comparison%20graph_accuracy(0422).avif)

## Unmatched accuracy

This accuracy ensures precise handling of complex layouts and tables.

- **5%+ higher** layout & table recognition vs. document processing models

[(DP-Bench benchmark ↗︎)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/upstage/dp-bench)

- **TEDS: 93.48**, **TEDS-S: 94.16**


[Learn more](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/let-llms-read-your-documents-with-speed-and-accuracy)

## Easy to use

Upstage Document Parse is designed to fit effortlessly into your existing systems:

[See developer docs ↗︎](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/document-digitization?utm_source=docs&utm_medium=web-product-dp&utm_campaign=document-parse)

```python

from langchain_upstage import UpstageDocumentParseLoader
loader = UpstageDocumentParseLoader("file_path", ocr="force")
```

## Competitive price

Enterprise-grade performance, without the enterprise price tag.

- **$0.01/page** via API (SOC2 & ISO 27001 certified)

- **AWS Marketplace**: $17/hour or $3k/month

[(View offers on AWS ↗︎)](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-lv5bnpdco7xoq?sr=0-3&ref_=beagle&applicationId=AWSMPContessa)

## Deploy anywhere — cloud, API, or on-prem

### REST API

Convert PDFs, scans, and emails into clean, machine-readable text ready for AI pipelines.

[Run in Console](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/document-digitization/document-parsing?utm_source=deploy-cta&utm_medium=web-product-dp&utm_campaign=document-parse)

### Marketplaces

Pull structured key-value data from invoices, claims, and contracts with audited accuracy.

[Launch via AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-lv5bnpdco7xoq?sr=0-3&ref_=beagle&applicationId=AWSMPContessa)

### On-premises

Enterprise-grade language model family optimized for speed and groundedness.
